subject: [hw] T01 -> lead: V-track blocker: V02 a32_route still misroutes 2 forms; harness ready otherwise
body:
Status: T01 harness is complete and proving itself. V03 loader passes my 97-kernel set (unresolved=0, all symbols found); with a /tmp core patch (exact hunk sent to V02 four times, and V12 independently), arm-O0 runs 86/97 kernels with 0 mismatches; only V17 VFP is missing. Current tree core (12:07) still has two case-0 errors:
1) QADD gate: `if (op2 == 5u) return arm_media;` steals `asr r0,r0,r1` = e1a00150 (bits27-23=00011; QADD is 00010). One-line fix: gate with `((insn >> 23) & 0x1Fu) == 0x02u` or V10s exact `(insn & 0x0F900FF0)==0x01000050`.
2) Extra load/store: `(op & 0x18)==0x18 && op2 in {9,B,D,F}` misses P=0/U=1 LDRH e15020b2 (and other P/U combinations); use the bits7-4 nibble test (B/D/F, or 9 with bits11-8=F) independent of bits24-23, with the multiply `(insn&0x0F0000F0)==0x90` first.
V12s check_routing.sh reports 2/7 current; my asmrun snippets add.s/rs.s pass, lh2.s fails at e15020b2. Once these two lines land, my run_diff should be green for A32; Thumb still waits for V15/V16/V17/V18-V20, which are in progress. Can you nudge hw-v02 or paste the consolidated hunk yourself? No other action needed from you.
